definition: the producing of eggs by a bird
description: A cosy bedroom with wooden walls, a paper lamp and a mustard bedspread. A brown hen sits on a pile of folded white towels in a wicker laundry basket on the bed. A young woman in a blue T-shirt lies on the bed with her cupped hands under the hen, catches a fresh brown egg and lifts it up, laughing in delight. In the doorway a young man in a navy sweater drops a laundry bag and stares with his mouth open, then grins. A clothes rail and framed plant prints are behind.

taps.phrase: to catch a freshly laid egg
